reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Shared-dispersion NB model with Normal effect shrinkage; simulations and new biological validation; heavier tails only a conditional future alternative.

checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution plan to consult and verify primary Methods, supplements or validated tool protocols and transfer their settings to the selected dataset. Documenting settings or calling a method standard is not that action.

checks.quote: These parameters are not supplied and therefore cannot be filled in here.
checks.reason: The requested proposed method remains without a selected normalization estimator, executable empirical-Bayes fitting/solver procedure or concrete lookup/calibration-to-choice workflow. Unknown source facts need not be invented, but implementation choices cannot all be deferred.

checks.quote: false-sign rate for null or near-null effects
checks.reason: The primary information gate uses a false-sign rate on exact-null and near-null effects without defining the null event, selected-set denominator or treatment of zero/near-zero signs. This is distinct from the otherwise explicit effect and attenuation endpoints.

checks.quote: prespecified power for effects of magnitude
checks.reason: Independent specimens and nested technical runs are recognized, but there is no actual power/precision target, simulation-replicate precision rule or stopping criterion for selecting sample size; prespecifying an unspecified target is not a quantitative plan.

checks.quote: Ideally, process them in a separate experimental batch
checks.reason: Condition-blind retrospective QC is useful, but the newly acquired validation cohort has no prospective allocation/processing randomization or balanced condition-within-batch rule and no equivalent documented substitute.

Outcome-blind eligibility is present, but failed model fits, missing validation measurements and simulation/validation stopping or maximal accrual are not operationalized or retained in a defined denominator.

The NB mean model is given, but the interval/uncertainty computation and selection-wide error or multiplicity rule remain undefined. A per-gene posterior threshold is not itself calibrated selected-list control.
Sensitivity analyses list prior scales, filtering and heavier tails without bounded settings or a concrete procedure deriving and locking them before confirmation.
Possible batch, normalization and prior failures are recognized, but no diagnostic measurement-to-cause-to-ordered repair/retest workflow is provided.

checks.quote: more biological replication or a preregistered alternative prior
checks.reason: The next-step alternatives do not specify what is frozen during repair, which changes are allowed, or fresh independent confirmation after an estimator revision.

checks.quote: All figures should be generated by versioned scripts directly from locked analysis tables.
checks.reason: Figure-source tables are planned, but there is no clean-environment rerun, numerical tolerance, resource/failure ledger or source-difference comparison.
